| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|----------|---------------------|
| tuning_mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| tuning_min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| lockbox_mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| lockbox_min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| worst_mdd | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

**Champion retains title** — better tuning stability and max drawdown, despite marginally similar lockbox performance.

## Observations
- Last candidate (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) showed improved lockbox_min robustness but significantly degraded tuning_min (0.05 vs 0.43) — suggests overfitting to specific regimes
- No candidates currently INCONCLUSIVE — pipeline is clear for next run

## Ready to Execute

```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidates

# 3. Generate fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

---

  - regime-dependent exposure spikes,
